content.value:
Agricogla — a worker-placement farming game (Agricola family).

- 14 rounds in 6 stages; harvests after rounds 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, 14.
- Each round, players alternate placing family members one at a time on UNOCCUPIED
  action spaces. A new action space is revealed each round.
- At each harvest: sown fields yield 1 crop each; pay 2 food per family member
  (newborns 1); animals breed (+1 per type with 2+ and room). Food shortfall =
  begging cards at -3 points each.
- Rooms cost 5 of your house material + 2 reed. Renovate wood->clay->stone. Family
  growth needs more rooms than members (except the stage-5 urgent space).
- Fences enclose pastures (1 wood each, 15 lifetime). Pasture capacity 2 animals
  per space, doubled per stable inside; one animal type per pasture (+1 house pet).
- Final score rewards balance across fields, pastures, grain, vegetables, sheep,
  boar, cattle, family size, renovated rooms, and cards; -1 per unused space.

global.value:
Read-only spectator feed: the @cogweb/core ServerMessage stream the live console
and replay viewer render (snapshot / event / status / lobby / reset frames). Each
turn places one worker; harvests trigger feeding. The saved replay is
{ protocol:"cogweb.replay.v1", frames: ServerMessage[] }. Spectators send nothing.

player.value:
Agricogla coworld player protocol (cogweb.player.v1).

Your container is a websocket CLIENT of the game host's /player endpoint (the URL,
already carrying ?slot=&token=, is in COWORLD_PLAYER_WS_URL). Frames:

- game -> player  welcome      { type, protocol:"cogweb.player.v1", slot, config:{players} }
- game -> player  observation  { type, id, seat, turn, view, reason, timeLeftMs }
- player -> game  reply        { type:"reply", id, decision }
- game -> player  final        { type:"final", scores:number[] }   // one per seat

`view` is your seat's REDACTED engine state (other farms' hands and the future
round deck are masked; your own hand is intact). `timeLeftMs` is your CHESS-CLOCK
budget: the total thinking time (ms) you have left for the whole game. The host
decrements it by the time each of your turns takes; when it hits 0 the host stops
asking you and plays RANDOM legal moves for your seat for the rest of the game, so
budget your compute. On each observation, decide a move and reply with the SAME id.
The move is either a worker placement (work phase) or a feeding plan (feeding
phase), keyed by view.phase:

- placement: { action:<spaceId>, ...args }   // e.g. {action:"forest"},
  {action:"farmland", spaces:[idx]}, {action:"lessons", occupation:<id>},
  {action:"r_fences", edges:[...]}, {action:"r_sow_bake", sow:[...], bake:[...]}.
- feeding:   { conversions: [ { via:"raw"|<cardId>, good:<commodity>, count:N } ] }

The host validates legality and re-requests (reason set) on a rejected move; an
absent/slow player falls back to the always-legal baseline. The standard
baseline + LLM players are bundled — see the source tree.

game.description: A four-player worker-placement farming benchmark: agents place family members on action spaces to gather resources, build a farm, raise animals, and grow a family. Most victory points after 14 rounds wins.

seed.description: Optional deterministic episode seed. Omit it for a fresh random deal per episode (the secure league default: the deal is a pure function of the seed, so a pinned seed published here would let a player re-derive every hidden hand).

tokens.description: Per-seat auth tokens injected by the runner; length is the seat count.

pace_ms.description: Minimum ms between automated decisions, for live viewing.

players.description: Per-seat player display names (seat order). The platform injects the real policy/player names here; the host labels each seat with them so replays and the live roster show real names instead of the engine defaults.

num_agents.description: Fixed seat count, declared so the league commissioner sizes each episode to the seats (post-#47 it no longer infers the count from the round's entrants); the host ignores it.

act_timeout_seconds.description: Per-decision budget before the scripted fallback takes the turn.

time_budget_seconds.description: Per-policy chess-clock total: the whole-episode thinking budget (default 300s = 5 min). The host reports the remaining budget to the policy each turn (observation.timeLeftMs) and plays random LEGAL moves for a seat once its budget is spent.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for both players to connect before starting anyway.

scores.description: Final victory points per seat, in seat order.

winner.description: Winning seat, or -1 on a tie.

player.name: Agricogla Scripted Baseline
player.description: Deterministic no-LLM heuristic (the engine's candidate scorer). Certifies the contract offline.

player.name: Agricogla LLM Baseline
player.description: A Bedrock-driven policy that plays the seat through the game's autopilot (system prompt + per-phase tool).

variants.name: Standard (4 players, 14 rounds)
variants.description: The default four-farmer game — a fresh random deal each episode.

commissioner.name: Agricogla Commissioner
commissioner.description: Agricogla tournament commissioner: shuffled_window seating (round-robin over rounds) with per-episode win-rate scoring. Bundled standalone with the coworld.
